does: Sends books to an Xteink X4 or X3 over your Wi-Fi. File Transfer must be open on the reader.
works: Xteink X4 and X3 · CrossPoint 1.3 or newer
target.x4.how: On the reader, open File Transfer and join your Wi-Fi. Its screen shows the address.
error.unreachable: Nothing answers at {address}. Is File Transfer open on the reader, and is it on this Wi-Fi?
error.not_a_reader: Something answers at {address}, but it is not a reader running CrossPoint
